services.name: AC Repair

policies.estimates: Estimates on new systems and ductwork are free. Repairs start with an $89 diagnostic so a tech can tell you exactly what's wrong before you spend anything.
policies.diagnostic: The diagnostic is $89 and gets credited toward the repair if you move forward with us the same day.
policies.payment: Cash, check, all major cards, and Zelle. Payment is due when the work is done.
policies.financing: Financing is available on new systems with approved credit — the office can walk you through the options.
policies.warranty: Our workmanship is warrantied for one year. Equipment carries the manufacturer's warranty, which varies by unit.
policies.afterhours: After-hours and weekend emergency calls carry an additional fee. The dispatcher will tell you the amount before anyone is sent.
policies.licensed: We're a licensed and insured Florida HVAC contractor. License number is on every estimate and invoice.
policies.arrival: We give a two-hour arrival window and the tech calls when he's on the way.

faqs.q: How much does a new AC cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your home, the efficiency you want, and the shape of your ductwork — so we won't guess at a number. Estimates on new systems are free and we'll put it in writing.

faqs.q: How soon can you get here?
faqs.a: Most no-cool calls get same-day or next-morning service. Tune-ups and estimates usually go out within a few days.

faqs.q: Do you charge just to come out?
faqs.a: Repairs carry an $89 diagnostic, credited toward the repair if you go ahead with us the same day. Estimates on new systems and ductwork are free.

faqs.q: My power bill is really high — can you help?
faqs.a: Usually yes. High bills normally trace back to a low refrigerant charge, a dirty coil, leaking ducts, or a system that's simply undersized. A tune-up catches most of it.

faqs.q: How often should I service my AC?
faqs.a: Once a year at minimum in Florida, twice is better — the units run nearly year-round down here. Most breakdowns we see were preventable.

faqs.q: Do you work on all brands?
faqs.a: Yes — Carrier, Trane, Rheem, Goodman, Lennox, American Standard and the rest. If it blows cold air we work on it.
